Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $95 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (11% odds) on crude reach $95. Closes in 4d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.
